data.gender_notes: Shamna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shamna is derived from the Sanskrit word Shama, which means calming, soothing, and tranquil. In Hindu mythology, Shamna is the name of a goddess who is the embodiment of love, beauty, and the moon. She is often depicted with a crescent moon on her forehead and is believed to bring peace and prosperity. The name Shamna carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Shamna usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
